summary: Frontend-only test of V1.1 Phase 1-3 (clean-slate migration, reworked Projection, compact farm Dashboard). 8/9 scenarios PASS. 1 CRITICAL web-only bug: 'Passer au patch suivant' confirm dialog uses React Native Alert.alert which is unimplemented on react-native-web for multi-button alerts, so when a patch has planned (unvalidated) expenses the user cannot advance — the button taps produce no dialog and no action. Advance works correctly when there are no planned expenses (direct archive). All other features verified: clean-slate (0/0 agents, 'Aucun objectif actif', empty ZZZdex), patch chaining (second patch startDate = first endDate; stepper +7 shifts following patches by +7), first-patch editable startDate vs non-first 'CALCULÉ AUTO' read-only, Situation actuelle TOTAL formula (10+floor(320/160)=12 tickets), expense flow with inline COÛT RÉEL box + Valider deducting from Master Tapes (100→70) and marking EFFECTUÉE while removing from PRÉVU restant, event-reward-coef testID present and wired in code (default=1), persistence of masterTapes/patches/validated expenses across page.reload confirmed (MT=35, EFFECTUÉE badge, 15 tickets, Patchs clôturés section all survive reload).

ui_bugs.issue: React Native's Alert.alert from 'react-native' is unimplemented on react-native-web for multi-button alerts. In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/projection.tsx:120-128 the confirm dialog never appears on the web preview — tapping next-patch-button with planned (actualCost===null) expenses is a silent no-op. Verified: dialogs=0 captured via page.on('dialog'), no 'Dépenses non réalisées'/'Non, passer' text in DOM, patch count unchanged. Advance works when there are no planned expenses (Alert.alert branch is skipped). Fix: wrap the confirm with Platform.OS==='web' using window.confirm, or use a custom in-sheet confirm UI (same pattern as the inline 'COÛT RÉEL' validation box).

issues: Occasional Playwright 'subtree intercepts pointer events' when clicking the Réglages tab — reproducible via get_by_text('Réglages', exact=True). Not a user-facing bug (manual taps work) but suggests the Pressable's hit target overlaps a sibling view with pointer-events auto. Low priority.

action_items: [CRITICAL] projection.tsx:120-128 — Replace React Native Alert.alert with a web-compatible confirm. Options: (a) if (Platform.OS==='web') { if (window.confirm('Il reste X dépense(s)... passer au suivant ?')) doAdvance(); } else { Alert.alert(...) }; or (b) render an inline confirm panel inside the BottomSheet (consistent with the inline 'COÛT RÉEL' validate box already used for expenses).

[Minor] Re-check /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx tab bar to ensure the Pressable area for each tab is on top of sibling text/icon views (hitSlop / zIndex) so Playwright and real touch devices don't hit the inner Text layer.
critical_code_review_comments: Migration (AppStore.tsx:119-164) correctly treats version<2 as fromV1 and clears agents/objectives/patches/pullSessions/archivedPatches while preserving user-authored presets, gameConfig and optionLists. Bumps version to 2 — idempotent on subsequent loads.

Projection engine (projectionEngine.ts): startTotal formula matches spec (MT + floor(poly/160) + floor(mono/160) + floor(residual/20)). Planned expenses (actualCost===null) subtract from projection; validated expenses are excluded from projection AND deducted from masterTapes exactly once (AppStore.validateExpense). No double-counting observed. ✅
advancePatch (AppStore.tsx:425-447) archives the current patch (using patchIncome/patchSpent snapshot), removes it, and re-anchors the new current patch's startDate to today. Clean implementation. ✅

Home dashboard (index.tsx:25-32) computes cumulative daysLeft across active objectives in order and derives delta vs daysUntil(obj.targetDate). Delta rendering: green ▲ when >=0, red ▼ when negative — matches spec. ✅
InlineNumber uses `selectTextOnFocus` + web `.select()` so overwriting an existing value (e.g. 10→100) does not append. Good UX. ✅

DateField stores ISO and renders JJ.MM.AAAA — chaining relies on toDate(iso) + addDays — tested chained end-of-patch1 == start-of-patch2 (gap 0 days, exclusive end). Stepper +7 correctly shifts following patches by +7 days.

testID coverage is excellent: patch-card-<id>, add-patch-button, patch-startdate, add-expense-button, expense-cost-<id>, expense-do-<id>, expense-delete-<id>, expense-real-<id>, expense-validate-<id>, next-patch-button, event-reward-coef, home-farm-card are all present and functional.

success_rate.frontend: 89% (8/9 scenarios PASS; 1 CRITICAL on Alert.alert web shim)

seed_data_creation: Through UI during tests: Situation actuelle set to MT=35/50/100 at various steps, 2 projection patches added, 1 validated expense (15 tickets, EFFECTUÉE), 1 archived patch (via no-planned-expense branch of advancePatch). Data lives in IndexedDB (zzz_companion_state_v1); each fresh Playwright context starts clean so main agent won't see this seed in their session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: URL: https://mobile-dev-blueprint.preview.emergentagent.com. App is 100% offline (no backend). Each fresh Playwright invocation gets a clean IndexedDB. Mobile viewport 390x844. Tab bar is text-based — use page.get_by_text('Projection', exact=True); the Réglages tab sometimes reports pointer intercept — fall back to JS click walking up to a Pressable element. Expense container has testID `expense-<id>`; use page.evaluate to extract matching IDs. BottomSheet close button testID = 'sheet-close'. Alert.alert on react-native-web does not fire — test via page.on('dialog') AND by checking DOM for the alert text; neither will appear until the main agent replaces Alert.alert with a web-compatible confirm.
rca_of_issue: Bug: Advance patch button silent on web when planned expenses exist. Reproduction: (1) Open Projection, add a patch, add at least one expense without validating it (actualCost===null). (2) Open the patch, tap 'Passer au patch suivant' (testID next-patch-button). Expected: a confirm dialog 'Dépenses non réalisées — Il reste N dépense(s) non réalisée(s). Souhaitez-vous les réaliser avant de passer au patch suivant ?' with buttons 'Oui, les réaliser' / 'Non, passer'. Observed on web: nothing happens — no native dialog, no DOM overlay, patch is not archived. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/projection.tsx line 3 imports `Alert` from 'react-native'. react-native-web's Alert.alert supports only single-button alerts via window.alert; multi-button alerts log a warning and are a no-op. Mitigation: Platform.OS==='web' branch using window.confirm (returns true for 'Non, passer' semantics), or replace with the already-existing inline confirm pattern used by the expense Valider box. The no-planned-expense branch (direct doAdvance()) works correctly on web (verified: 1 patch → 0 patches, 'Patchs clôturés' section appears).
